**Finding submitted: INSURANCE — missing (confidence 0.9).**

- **Investigation:** Searches for "insurance", "coverage/certificate/insurer" and "liability" returned nothing responsive; a full read of the General Provisions (§§ 10.1–10.8) and of HDI's obligations (§§ 1.4–1.8, 5, 8) confirms no insurance covenant exists anywhere. HDI hosts and operates the Site, creates order export files and accesses Company Content and user information, so the rule is engaged and no-cover is walk-away territory.
- **Cure:** One `insert_after` p0070 adding Section 10.9 carrying only the six preferred elements — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber and privacy USD 5M where HDI processes any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for the Company, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request. No survival tail, at-own-expense or other non-element boilerplate was added, and no neighbouring clause was rewritten. Fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) offered in the comment.
